subject: Iris Analytics: SIG walkthrough scheduling & artifacts request
messages:
From: Emma Patel <emma@iris-analytics.com>
To: naomi_feldman@redwood.ai
Cc: liam.chen@iris-analytics.com
Date: 2027-05-02T10:14:00-07:00
Subject: SIG/CAIQ walkthrough request and availability

Hi Naomi,

Thanks for taking this — Iris Analytics is starting our SIG/CAIQ review of vendors this quarter. We'd like to schedule a 45–60 min walkthrough to review Redwood's CAIQ surface, data residency controls, and logging retention. Our security lead (Liam) will join.

High-level asks for the call:
- Quick CAIQ/SIG Q&A (30 min)
- Review evidence artifacts and where to find them (10–15 min)
- Confirm log retention / access for audit (5–10 min)

Our availability next week (PST): Tue 5/4 9–12, Wed 5/5 10–3, Fri 5/7 morning.

Attached is our intake packet with a short questionnaire and a copy of our standard mutual NDA.

Thanks,
Emma
Emma Patel
Security Program Manager
Iris Analytics
Attachment: Iris_SIG_Packet_v1.pdf (pdf)
Attachment: Iris_NDA_signed.pdf (pdf)

From: naomi_feldman@redwood.ai
To: Emma Patel <emma@iris-analytics.com>
Cc: liam.chen@iris-analytics.com, soojin_lee@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-05-02T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SIG/CAIQ walkthrough request and availability

Hi Emma — great to meet you (virtually). Thanks for sending the packet and NDA. We reviewed the intake and would be happy to run the walkthrough.

Proposed slots (PST):
- Tue 5/4 09:30–10:15
- Wed 5/5 11:00–12:00
- Fri 5/7 09:00–09:45

Can you confirm which works best? I'll loop in Soojin (solutions security) and Marissa (eng owner) so they can cover evidence and retention details.

Pre-call asks from our side so we can be efficient on the call:
- Can you mark any questions in the CAIQ that are high priority (redline) so we focus time?
- Any specific auditors/standards we should address beyond SOC 2/CAIQ?
- Are there any specific sample log time ranges you want (e.g., last 7 days vs. last 90)?

We can also pre-share a short evidence index so you have links to the artifacts before the call.

Best,
Naomi Feldman
Account Executive — Enterprise
Redwood Inference

From: soojin_lee@redwood.ai
To: Emma Patel <emma@iris-analytics.com>, naomi_feldman@redwood.ai
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, liam.chen@iris-analytics.com
Date: 2027-05-02T13:28:00-07:00
Subject: RE: SIG/CAIQ walkthrough request and availability

Hi Emma — copying a short evidence checklist so you can see what we plan to surface during the walkthrough. I can present the CAIQ mapping and show where each artifact lives.

Evidence checklist (what we'll prep):
- SOC 2 Type II report (latest) — summary + redacted report link
- CAIQ matrix with redline notes for any controls outside our scope
- Network diagram + VPC boundaries (pdf)
- Audit log samples (redacted) — tenant-level access, auth logs, and admin actions (we can provide 7/30/90-day views)
- KMS key rotation logs (high level)
- Data residency & dataflow diagram (region mappings)
- Pen test summary and critical/high remediation notes
- Roles & responsibilities contact list (owners for each artifact)

Attachments I'll share pre-call: evidence_index.csv (index + links), redwood_dataflow_region_map.png. I'll upload these to a shared Drive and post links.

For the slot, Naomi — we prefer Wed 5/5 11:00–12:00 PST so Marissa can join to cover retention.

Thanks,
Soojin Lee
Security Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
Attachment: evidence_index.csv (csv)
Attachment: redwood_dataflow_region_map.png (png)

Thanks team — confirming internal owners and runbook for the call.

Owners:
